What's the difference between Essentials and Growth?

Essentials ($297/month) is your professionally designed website with hosting, SSL, maintenance, updates, support and foundational on-page SEO, plus automated review requests, instant new-lead response and missed-call text-back. Growth ($597/month) adds a GoHighLevel CRM, advanced SMS and email follow-up, appointment scheduling and Google Search Ads setup and ongoing management with monthly reporting. Google Ads spend is paid separately, directly to Google.

There's no setup fee on either plan; your first month is due at signup. Essentials can be cancelled anytime. Growth has a 3-month minimum commitment, and its cancellation terms are set out in your service agreement. Submitting the form doesn't charge you anything.
